purpose: Remove the Kubernetes deep-outbox acceptance race where label-selector log collection includes a pod deleted during worker scale-down and returns NotFound after all measured runtime thresholds already passed.
requiredBehavior: wait for terminating outbox-worker pods to disappear after scale-down
assert exactly two active final worker pods
collect logs from the exact stable pod names rather than a racing label selector
preserve all existing deep-runtime thresholds and fail-closed behavior
report final log collection and forbidden runtime log failures precisely
forbiddenCapabilities: weakening or skipping deep outbox runtime scenarios
tolerating fewer or more than two final worker replicas
changing production worker code database schema network policies or authority
